title: Tiny, cute corn cob
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow/glow base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#5A4A00' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- husk leaves behind -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q18 45 22 25 Q30 38 34 52Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <path d='M70 55 Q82 45 78 25 Q70 38 66 52Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <path d='M33 52 Q24 38 30 22 Q36 36 38 50Z' fill='#66BB6A' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M67 52 Q76 38 70 22 Q64 36 62 50Z' fill='#66BB6A' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- husk leaves front bottom -->
  <path d='M35 68 Q24 78 26 90 Q36 84 42 72Z' fill='#43A047'/>
  <path d='M65 68 Q76 78 74 90 Q64 84 58 72Z' fill='#43A047'/>
  <!-- corn body main -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='17' ry='28' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- kernel rows: slightly lighter/contrasting dots -->
  <g fill='#FFF3B0'>
    <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='38' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='38' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='53' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='52' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='52' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='53' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='60' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='59' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='60' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='66' r='2.4'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='66' r='2.4'/>
  </g>
  <!-- darker kernel accents for depth -->
  <g fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.6'>
    <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='49' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='63' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='63' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <g>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='44' cy='42' rx='2.6' ry='3' fill='#3B2A00'/>
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='42' rx='2.6' ry='3' fill='#3B2A00'/>
    <circle cx='44.8' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#FFF9D6'/>
    <circle cx='56.8' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#FFF9D6'/>
    <!-- rosy cheeks -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF9E80' opacity='0.7'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF9E80' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- tiny smile -->
    <path d='M46 50 Q50 54 54 50' fill='none' stroke='#8B6500' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
